## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(telematics): …`, `fix(rental): …`).
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`); I agree to the terms in
      [Licensing of contributions](../CONTRIBUTING.md#licensing-of-contributions),
      including that my contribution is unpaid.
- [ ] Tests cover the change; `make lint test` passes.
- [ ] Not a vulnerability report: those go through [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
